_readme: Hand-maintained. The weekly job never overwrites this file.
entries:   papers no index knows about yet (under review, in press). Written out as-is.
overrides: presentation fields keyed by the lower-cased, punctuation-stripped title.
Anything set here wins over whatever Google Scholar or OpenAlex returns.
exclude:   normalised titles to drop (duplicates, wrong-Zhang papers, abstracts).
Fields: authors uses **bold** for your own name, status is published|review|preprint,
badge kinds are top|rank|oral|review|plain, thumb is a path under img_journal/.
